content.bridge_context: Studying the different types of forests and animals across the globe.

units.title: What is Natural Vegetation?
units.explanation: Plants that grow naturally without human interference.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify a wild plant in your locality. / अपने इलाके के एक जंगली पौधे की पहचान करें।

units.title: Types of Forests
units.explanation: Tropical Evergreen, Deciduous, Coniferous, and Grasslands.
units.dual_language_instruction: Which trees don't shed their leaves? / कौन से पेड़ अपने पत्ते नहीं झाड़ते?
